title: Product convergence from scalar Lipschitz convergence
statement:
Let $(\mu_m)_{m\ge0}$ and $
u$ be probability measures on $\mathbb R$. Suppose that for every $c\ge0$ and every $c$-Lipschitz function $\psi:\mathbb R	o\mathbb R$, $\int\psi\,d\mu_m	o\int\psi\,d
u$ as $m	o\infty$. Then, for every $n\ge0$ and bounded continuous $F:\mathbb R^n	o\mathbb R$, $\int F\,d\mu_m^{\otimes n}	o\int F\,d
u^{\otimes n}$.

$\nu$ is a probability measure on $\mathbb R$
